purpose: Minimal compositional extension of AssertionCarrier v1 derived from the frozen AHV-8 held-out gaps; intended for validation only on a newly admitted post-v2 held-out set.

scope_boundary.derivation_set: AHV-8 v1 held-out gaps from issue #382
scope_boundary.note: AHV-8 is derivation/calibration evidence for v2. Independent validation requires a new source set admitted after this schema freeze.

directionality.semantics: Orthogonal directional information over an otherwise typed assertion. It does not create a new predicate family.

evaluation.semantics: Orthogonal evaluative ordering for a comparison. The preferred argument must already be a frozen source argument.

carrier_fields.source_arguments: exact ordered frozen ClaimIR relation arguments
carrier_fields.qualifiers: zero or more orthogonal assertion qualifiers
carrier_fields.argument_bindings: typed roles for source arguments bound to L_sys, L_ctx, or an L_claim claim object
carrier_fields.semantic_references: additional semantically required references to existing ClaimIR nodes omitted from source_arguments
carrier_fields.support_provenance: assertion-level provenance separate from P_in unless an intervention node exists
carrier_fields.assertion_scope_qualifiers: incidental scope only; never substitutes for a missing core predicate/modifier

invariants: source_arguments and source_kind reproduce frozen ClaimIR exactly
v2 is a strict additive superset of v1 vocabulary; no v1 predicate, qualifier, role, context class, or provenance type is removed or redefined
L_claim argument bindings are allowed only for ClaimIR nodes explicitly typed as non-system claim objects such as competing theoretical accounts; they may not be used to evade L_sys/L_ctx placement
L_claim argument bindings require claim_object_type=THEORETICAL_ACCOUNT in v2
directionality is orthogonal to predicate_family and may not replace the underlying relation type
directionality.target_argument must be one of the frozen source_arguments
evaluation is permitted only with predicate_family=COMPARISON
evaluation.preferred_argument must be one of the frozen source_arguments
semantic_references may reference only existing ClaimIR nodes absent from source_arguments
assertion_scope_qualifiers may not encode missing core predicate, directionality, evaluation, negation, ordering, or distinction semantics
support provenance does not create P_in when frozen ClaimIR lacks an intervention node
carrier FULL denotes representational coverage under the schema, not truth, evidential strength, or logical completeness
validation_boundary: No completeness claim is licensed by AHV-8 retrospective closure. A new post-v2 held-out set is mandatory.
